description: push_refusal::parse and remedy: git's stderr when a team's host refused a push. `expect` is null for stderr that is no refusal of the host.

cases.note: The team is out of room: pushes stop until the plan grows.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: quota
remote: 262144000 bytes over a quota of 209715200
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

cases.note: The clone holds a path outside the team's tree: the paths follow the code, one a line.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: pathDenied
remote: history.jsonl
remote: desktop/card.json
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

cases.note: The paid term ran out over the free room: the cabinet's matter.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: readOnly
remote: the team reads only: renew it in the cabinet
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

lines: the team reads only: renew it in the cabinet

cases.note: The host is short of disk for now: tried again next tick, no pause.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: diskReserve
remote: 512 MiB free, 1 GiB kept in reserve
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

lines: 512 MiB free, 1 GiB kept in reserve

cases.note: The tick's own words around git's stderr: the refusal is found inside.
cases.stderr:
push to origin refused with 3 commit(s) waiting: remote: vibememory: notAMember
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

cases.note: A code of a newer host: stop pushing and ask later, never push harder.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: somethingNew
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'

cases.note: A network failure is not a refusal: the ordinary back-off handles it.
cases.stderr:
ssh: connect to host vibememory.ru port 22: Operation timed out
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

cases.note: Only a code of letters and digits counts: a line of prose after the mark is not one.
cases.stderr:
remote: vibememory: something went wrong
To vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (pre-receive hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'vibememory.ru:teams/acme.git'
